// Synthetic characterization of unchanged pinned AZQR availability arithmetic.
package availability

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/az"
	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/scanners/plugins/region/sku"
	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/scanners/plugins/region/types"
)

type availabilityCaptureTripwire struct{}

func (availabilityCaptureTripwire) RoundTrip(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	panic("availability capture attempted HTTP")
}

type availabilityCaptureProvider struct {
	resourceType string
	response     map[string]types.SKUAvailability
	failure      bool
	calls        int
}

func (p *availabilityCaptureProvider) ResourceType() string { return p.resourceType }

func (p *availabilityCaptureProvider) FetchSKUs(_ context.Context, subscription, region string, client *az.HttpClient) (map[string]types.SKUAvailability, error) {
	if subscription != "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111" || region != "westeurope" || client != nil {
		panic("availability capture provider arguments changed")
	}
	p.calls++
	if p.failure {
		return nil, errors.New("synthetic unavailable provider")
	}
	return p.response, nil
}

type availabilityCaptureCase struct {
	Source       string
	Target       string
	Inventory    *types.ResourceInventory
	Providers    *types.ResourceTypeLocationData
	Zones        map[string]int
	SKUEnabled   bool
	Cancelled    bool
}

func TestRegionAvailabilityCalculationCapture(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("REGION_AVAILABILITY_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing capture output directory")
	}
	oldTransport, oldClient := http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient
	http.DefaultTransport = availabilityCaptureTripwire{}
	http.DefaultClient = &http.Client{Transport: availabilityCaptureTripwire{}}
	defer func() { http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient = oldTransport, oldClient }()

	available := &availabilityCaptureProvider{
		resourceType: "microsoft.capture/available",
		response: map[string]types.SKUAvailability{
			" Ready ": {State: types.SKUAvailable},
			"restricted": {State: types.SKURestricted},
			"zones": {State: types.SKUZoneRestricted, BlockedZones: []string{"3", "1", "3"}},
			"zones-empty": {State: types.SKUZoneRestricted},
			"missing": {State: types.SKUUnavailable},
			"future": {State: types.SKUAvailabilityState(99)},
		},
	}
	failed := &availabilityCaptureProvider{resourceType: "microsoft.capture/failed", failure: true}
	sku.Register(available)
	sku.Register(failed)

	providers := &types.ResourceTypeLocationData{Data: map[string]map[string]map[string]struct{}{
		"microsoft.compute": {"virtualmachines": {"westeurope": {}}},
		"microsoft.network": {"virtualnetworks": {"eastus": {}}, "privatednszones": {"global": {}}},
		"microsoft.capture": {"available": {"westeurope": {}}, "failed": {"westeurope": {}}},
	}}
	empty := &types.ResourceInventory{ResourceTypesByRegion: map[string]map[string]int{}, SKUsByTypeAndRegion: map[string]map[string]map[string]int{}}
	emptySource := &types.ResourceInventory{ResourceTypesByRegion: map[string]map[string]int{"eastus": {}}, SKUsByTypeAndRegion: map[string]map[string]map[string]int{}}
	mixed := &types.ResourceInventory{
		ResourceTypesByRegion: map[string]map[string]int{"eastus": {
			"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines": 900,
			"microsoft.network/virtualnetworks": 1,
			"microsoft.network/privatednszones": 0,
			"microsoft.custom/widgets": 7,
		}},
		SKUsByTypeAndRegion: map[string]map[string]map[string]int{
			"microsoft.compute/virtualmachines": {"eastus": {"Standard_D4s_v3": 12}},
		},
	}
	skus := &types.ResourceInventory{
		ResourceTypesByRegion: map[string]map[string]int{"eastus": {
			"microsoft.capture/available": 200,
			"microsoft.custom/widgets": 2,
		}},
		SKUsByTypeAndRegion: map[string]map[string]map[string]int{
			"microsoft.capture/available": {
				"eastus": {"Ready": 100, " ready ": 1, "restricted": 1, "zones": 1, "zones-empty": 1, "missing": 1, "absent": 1, "future": 1},
				"northeurope": {"not-source": 1},
			},
			"microsoft.custom/widgets": {"eastus": {"ignored-provider": 1}},
		},
	}
	unknown := &types.ResourceInventory{
		ResourceTypesByRegion: map[string]map[string]int{"eastus": {"microsoft.capture/failed": 1}},
		SKUsByTypeAndRegion: map[string]map[string]map[string]int{
			"microsoft.capture/failed": {"eastus": {"First": 1, "Second": 2}},
		},
	}
	combined := &types.ResourceInventory{
		ResourceTypesByRegion: map[string]map[string]int{"eastus": {"microsoft.capture/available": 1, "microsoft.capture/failed": 1}},
		SKUsByTypeAndRegion: map[string]map[string]map[string]int{
			"microsoft.capture/available": {"eastus": {"Ready": 1, "restricted": 1}},
			"microsoft.capture/failed": {"eastus": {"Unknown": 1}},
		},
	}
	zones := map[string]int{"eastus": 3, "westeurope": 2}
	cases := map[string]availabilityCaptureCase{
		"source-absent": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: empty, Providers: providers, Zones: zones, SKUEnabled: true},
		"source-present-empty": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: emptySource, Providers: providers, Zones: zones, SKUEnabled: true},
		"resource-mixed-no-sku": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: mixed, Providers: providers, Zones: zones},
		"resource-empty-providers": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: mixed, Providers: &types.ResourceTypeLocationData{}, Zones: zones},
		"source-key-exact-case": {Source: "East US", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: mixed, Providers: providers, Zones: zones, SKUEnabled: true},
		"target-key-exact-case": {Source: "eastus", Target: "West Europe", Inventory: mixed, Providers: providers, Zones: zones},
		"sku-all-states": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: skus, Providers: providers, Zones: zones, SKUEnabled: true},
		"sku-disabled": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: skus, Providers: providers, Zones: zones},
		"sku-all-unknown": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: unknown, Providers: providers, Zones: zones, SKUEnabled: true},
		"sku-mixed-unknown": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: combined, Providers: providers, Zones: zones, SKUEnabled: true},
		"cancelled-source-ignores-context": {Source: "eastus", Target: "westeurope", Inventory: combined, Providers: providers, Zones: zones, SKUEnabled: true, Cancelled: true},
	}
	results := map[string]types.RegionComparison{}
	for name, input := range cases {
		ctx := context.Background()
		if input.Cancelled {
			cancelled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
			cancel()
			ctx = cancelled
		}
		var cache *sku.Cache
		if input.SKUEnabled {
			cache = sku.NewCache()
		}
		got := checkRegionAvailability(ctx, "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111", input.Source, input.Target, input.Inventory, input.Providers, nil, cache, input.Zones)
		// Source iterates maps; canonicalize only set-like detail list order.
		// Preserve every list element, exact identifiers and blocked-zone order.
		sort.Strings(got.MissingResourceTypes)
		sort.Strings(got.MissingSKUs)
		sort.Strings(got.RestrictedSKUs)
		sort.Strings(got.ZoneRestrictedSKUs)
		results[name] = got
	}
	type probe struct {
		ResourceType string
		Region       string
		Available    bool
	}
	probes := []probe{
		{ResourceType: "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines", Region: "westeurope"},
		{ResourceType: "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines", Region: "West Europe"},
		{ResourceType: "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines", Region: "westeurope"},
		{ResourceType: "microsoft.network/privatednszones", Region: "private-region"},
		{ResourceType: "microsoft.network/privatednszones", Region: ""},
		{ResourceType: "microsoft.custom/widgets", Region: "westeurope"},
		{ResourceType: "malformed", Region: "westeurope"},
		{ResourceType: "microsoft.compute/virtualmachines/child", Region: "westeurope"},
	}
	for i := range probes {
		probes[i].Available = providers.IsAvailable(probes[i].ResourceType, probes[i].Region)
	}
	inputs := map[string]any{"cases": cases, "sku_response": available.response, "sku_error": failed.failure}
	outputs := map[string]any{"cases": results, "provider_lookup": probes, "provider_calls": map[string]int{"available": available.calls, "failed": failed.calls}}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(output, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for name, value := range map[string]any{"source-availability-inputs.json": inputs, "source-availability-outputs.json": outputs} {
		raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, name), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("Captured %d availability branches and %d provider lookup cases; pure synthetic SKU providers, no service client/credential/network invoked", len(cases), len(probes))
}
